# NeuroRing_Topology

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A ring-based interconnection topology for connecting multiple FPGAs in a circular fashion to support distributed spiking neural network execution. Provides a scalable and cost-effective physical layout for multi-FPGA neuromorphic systems, balancing bandwidth and wiring complexity.
